content.comment_body: [product_name] [version_no] [version_no] [version_no] I created a complex program for building heating control. PDC FINAL 25 - Initially, retention was functioning, but now it has stopped working on several blocks after repeated blackouts throughout the day. Occasionally, the log file cannot be found even though I'm certain the log should be written. When attempting to download to [product_name], I see an error stating memory is full. Despite this, I am able to successfully download and run the program. An SD card is installed and shows as OK. Current free memory on [product_name]: bytes = 3284 blocks = 78 rem = 20 However, if I manually adjust values of B261, B137, B092, for example, after a blackout the changed values are lost and revert to their initial settings. Is this a bug? Can anyone explain this behavior? I plan to upload the program for review. Hopefully, this information will assist others who use temperature settings and [product_name] network connections, as I am still learning and seeking more examples. Thanks for any support.
Please review the attachment. Is this the error message you were referring to?

No, that isn't the message I'm seeing. Everything is fine regarding block count and [product_name] resources. I can still add blocks. The error only appears during download, but after confirming, everything works. Regarding the log file, sometimes it's missing; I suspect the SD card quality might be the cause. About the retention issue—I want to save temperature settings. It worked initially, but stopped when the program grew larger. Could it be a faulty battery? Is data retention managed by a battery within [product_name]?
The error "Unable to download because the [product_name] memory is full" is unfamiliar to me. I recommend starting a support request.

The [product_name] [article_no] does not have an internal battery for storing programs and data. It uses FLASH memory, which retains both the program and retentive data after power loss. Not all blocks have retentive memory. Data will be cleared only after a restart following a program transfer from a PC to [product_name].

Hello [user_name], As [user_name] has already suggested, we advise you to open a service request. I can forward your case to the [company_name] support team for tailored assistance. Please check your private messages for more details about your individual support request. Your [product_name] Support

analysis.insight_summary: The user is encountering problems with [product_name] [version_no] retention and log memory functions, particularly after frequent power outages. Set values are not reliably maintained, and log files are sporadically missing. Memory error messages appear during download but do not prevent successful operation, making them unclear. There is also confusion about whether retention is battery-backed or FLASH-based and which blocks support retention.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants consistent preservation of custom values through power cycles, reliable log creation, and clarity regarding actual memory status. Additionally, the user seeks a better understanding of [product_name]'s internal memory, specifically if retention requires battery backup, and which blocks support this feature.
